import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class ModInt {
        static int MOD;
        private int val;

        static void setMod(int mod) {
            MOD = mod;
        }

        ModInt() {
            this(0);
        }

        ModInt(long v) {
            int x = (int)(v % MOD);
            if (x < 0) x += MOD;
            val = x;
        }

        ModInt(int v) {
            this((long)v);
        }

        int val() {
            return val;
        }

        ModInt add(ModInt other) {
            int x = val + other.val;
            if (x >= MOD) x -= MOD;
            return new ModInt(x);
        }

        ModInt sub(ModInt other) {
            int x = val - other.val;
            if (x < 0) x += MOD;
            return new ModInt(x);
        }

        ModInt mul(ModInt other) {
            long prod = (long)val * other.val % MOD;
            return new ModInt((int)prod);
        }

        ModInt div(ModInt other) {
            return mul(other.inv());
        }

        ModInt pow(long e) {
            ModInt r = new ModInt(1);
            ModInt b = this;
            while (e > 0) {
                if ((e & 1) == 1) r = r.mul(b);
                b = b.mul(b);
                e >>= 1;
            }
            return r;
        }

        ModInt inv() {
            // MOD is prime (as per atcoder usage), but we use modular inverse via pow
            return pow(MOD - 2);
        }

        // static helpers
        static ModInt of(long v) {
            return new ModInt(v);
        }

        static ModInt zero() {
            return new ModInt(0);
        }
    }

    // Pair class for ModInt
    static class Pair {
        ModInt first;
        ModInt second;
        Pair(ModInt f, ModInt s) {
            first = f;
            second = s;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);

        // read n, m, mod
        String[] parts = br.readLine().split(" ");
        int n = Integer.parseInt(parts[0]);
        int m = Integer.parseInt(parts[1]);
        int mod = Integer.parseInt(parts[2]);
        ModInt.setMod(mod);

        // binomial coefficients C[n][k]
        ModInt[][] C = new ModInt[n + 1][n + 1];
        C[0][0] = ModInt.of(1);
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            C[i][0] = ModInt.of(1);
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                C[i][j] = C[i - 1][j - 1].add(C[i - 1][j]);
            }
        }

        // g[i] = i * (i + 1) / 2
        ModInt[] g = new ModInt[n + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            g[i] = ModInt.of((long)i * (i + 1) / 2);
        }

        // f[i] = (pattern count, sum of madness)
        Pair[] f = new Pair[n + 1];
        f[0] = new Pair(ModInt.of(1), ModInt.zero());

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            f[i] = new Pair(ModInt.zero(), ModInt.zero());
            for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
                ModInt z = f[j].first.mul(f[i - 1 - j].first).mul(C[i - 1][j]);
                // first += z * (i + 1)
                f[i].first = f[i].first.add(z.mul(ModInt.of(i + 1)));
                // second += z * (g[j] + g[i-1-j])
                f[i].second = f[i].second.add(z.mul(g[j].add(g[i - 1 - j])));
                // second += (f[i-1-j].first * f[j].second + f[j].first * f[i-1-j].second) * C[i-1][j] * (i+1)
                ModInt tmp = f[i - 1 - j].first.mul(f[j].second).add(f[j].first.mul(f[i - 1 - j].second));
                f[i].second = f[i].second.add(tmp.mul(C[i - 1][j]).mul(ModInt.of(i + 1)));
            }
        }

        // dp[l][i] = Pair(first, second)
        // dimensions: l from 0 to n+1, i from 0 to m
        Pair[][] dp = new Pair[n + 2][m + 1];
        for (int l = 0; l <= n + 1; l++) {
            for (int i = 0; i <= m; i++) {
                dp[l][i] = new Pair(ModInt.zero(), ModInt.zero());
            }
        }
        dp[0][0] = new Pair(ModInt.of(1), ModInt.zero());

        for (int l = 0; l <= n; l++) {
            for (int r = l + 1; r <= n + 1; r++) {
                int di = r - l - 1;
                if (di > m) continue;
                for (int i = 0; i + di <= m; i++) {
                    // combine
                    ModInt z = dp[l][i].first.mul(f[di].first);
                    // dp[r][i+di].first += z * C[i+di][di]
                    dp[r][i + di].first = dp[r][i + di].first.add(z.mul(C[i + di][di]));
                    // dp[r][i+di].second += (dp[l][i].second * f[di].first + dp[l][i].first * f[di].second) * C[i+di][di]
                    ModInt tmp = dp[l][i].second.mul(f[di].first).add(dp[l][i].first.mul(f[di].second));
                    dp[r][i + di].second = dp[r][i + di].second.add(tmp.mul(C[i + di][di]));
                }
            }
        }

        pw.println(dp[n + 1][m].second.val());
        pw.flush();
        pw.close();
        br.close();
    }
}
